# Italia Cosmetics - AI Context

Welcome to the LLM index for Italia Cosmetics. We are the premier online destination for professional haircare and skincare in Pakistan, specializing in world-renowned salon-grade brands including Genus, Versum, Maxylook, and UNA (Rolland USA).

## Company Overview & Value Proposition
- **Authenticity**: 100% genuine products sourced directly from manufacturers.
- **Audience**: Professional salons and discerning individuals seeking salon-quality results at home.
- **Mission**: To bring the world's finest professional haircare science to your door.

## Customer Service & Policies
- **Shipping**: We offer FREE shipping on all orders over 5000 PKR. Use code ITALIA10 at checkout.
- **Support**: Customers can track their orders and access help directly through our website.
- **Availability**: Our premium collections are designed to address specific hair needs, from color protection to deep hydration and scalp care.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Q: Are these products authentic?** A: Yes, all products are 100% authentic professional-grade cosmetics.
- **Q: Do you offer free shipping?** A: Yes, on orders over 5000 PKR using the code ITALIA10.
- **Q: What brands do you carry?** A: We exclusively carry Maxylook, Genus, Versum, and UNA.
